title: Fit the rig and start the first cycle
purpose: Every wearer starts the first cycle with the camera on their head, recording on their own account.
when: Every shift, after checkout, before 8:00 AM.

steps.do: Check safety gear, then fit cap, mount, and phone.
steps.detail: The mount goes on a cap or certified helmet only. Pull on the phone and the mount. Tether the phone at height.

steps.do: Set the angle at the wearer's task.
steps.detail: No screen, payment card, ID, or customer information. No restroom, locker room, prayer room, clinic, or office nearby.
steps.check: The screen shows only hands and the work.

steps.do: Say the pocket card rules out loud.
steps.check: The wearer says it back: stop first, then the hat.

steps.do: Tell the Portfolio Manager who is new today.
steps.check: They have each new name and device number.

steps.do: Start the first cycle at 8:00 AM.
steps.detail: Check the name on the screen is the wearer's own. Start only with hands on the work, then walk the line.
steps.check: Every phone records on the right name and nothing slips.

done: By 8:00 AM every wearer is recording on their own account, camera on their hands and work.

fails.if: A cap, mount, or helmet is missing or loose
fails.then: Fit the spare, note the device number, and tell the Portfolio Manager this shift. No helmet, no floor.

fails.if: The angle is wrong, or something forbidden is in view
fails.then: That wearer does not start. Tell the Portfolio Manager before 8:00 AM. They find another task.

fails.if: The collection app fails, or shows another name
fails.then: Wrong name: the wearer sits out. App fault: use a charged spare. Tell the Portfolio Manager now.

fails.if: Hat off without tapping stop, or a personal phone out
fails.then: Tap stop now. Say the rule again. Tell the Portfolio Manager before they film again.

escalate: Your Portfolio Manager before 8:00 AM if a wearer cannot start. No reply in 20 minutes, call Moharam.
